description: Debug stepping lets real browser timers fire before transient-state assertions. Control browser time for grace period, retry threshold and restored notice; retain end-to-end host delivery checks and reproduce slow stepping.

comments.text: Diagnosis: failure is test line 561 expecting no banner after real-time disconnect and separate awaited steps. Widget contract intentionally shows banner after 2000ms. Inspector pauses allow timer to fire; expected zero is stale. Same risk at transient Connected assertion. Owner is test timing, not reconnect UI. Installed Playwright clock before navigation and pause after load; explicitly advance grace/retry/restored periods while preserving actual WebSocket/server/mock traffic. Normal Chromium run passed. Validating delayed stepping across browsers next.

title: Make reconnect UI timing assertions deterministic in debug mode
